title: EpMYB2 positively regulates chicoric acid biosynthesis by activating both primary and specialized metabolic genes in purple coneflower.
authors: Jin, Ge; Deng, Zongbi; Wang, Hsihua; Zhang, Yang; Fu, Rao
journal: The Plant journal : for cell and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫锥菊中转录因子EpMYB2调控菊苣酸生物合成，涉及TF-DNA结合（EpMYC2结合G-box）但无AI或物理模拟方法，属纯实验生物学研究，与本课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Chicoric acid is the major active ingredient of the world-popular medicinal plant purple coneflower (Echinacea purpurea (L.) Menoch). It is recognized as the quality index of commercial hot-selling Echinacea products. While the biosynthetic pathway of chicoric acid in purple coneflower has been elucidated recently, its regulatory network remains elusive. Through co-expression and phylogenetic analysis, we found EpMYB2, a typical R2R3-type MYB transcription factor (TF) responsive to methyl jasmonate (MeJA) simulation, is a positive regulator of chicoric acid biosynthesis. In addition to directly regulating chicoric acid biosynthetic genes, EpMYB2 positively regulates genes of the upstream shikimate pathway. We also found that EpMYC2 could activate the expression of EpMYB2 by binding to its G-box site, and the EpMYC2-EpMYB2 module is involved in the MeJA-induced chicoric acid biosynthesis. Overall, we identified an MYB TF that positively regulates the biosynthesis of chicoric acid by activating both primary and specialized metabolic genes. EpMYB2 links the gap between the JA signaling pathway and chicoric acid biosynthesis. This work opens a new direction toward engineering purple coneflower with higher medicinal qualities.
abstract_zh: 菊苣酸是全球广受欢迎的药用植物紫锥菊（Echinacea purpurea (L.) Menoch）的主要活性成分，被公认为商业热销紫锥菊产品的质量指标。尽管紫锥菊中菊苣酸的生物合成途径近期已被阐明，其调控网络仍不明确。通过共表达和系统发育分析，我们发现EpMYB2——一种典型的R2R3型MYB转录因子（transcription factor, TF），响应茉莉酸甲酯（methyl jasmonate, MeJA）模拟处理——是菊苣酸生物合成的正调控因子。除了直接调控菊苣酸生物合成基因外，EpMYB2还正调控上游莽草酸途径的基因。我们还发现EpMYC2可通过结合其G-box位点激活EpMYB2的表达，且EpMYC2-EpMYB2模块参与MeJA诱导的菊苣酸生物合成。总体而言，我们鉴定了一个通过激活初级和特化代谢基因正调控菊苣酸生物合成的MYB转录因子。EpMYB2连接了JA信号通路与菊苣酸生物合成之间的缺口。这项工作为工程化改良紫锥菊以提高其药用品质开辟了新方向。
